name: RITA Beaconing Auto-Response
description: When RITA detects beaconing (score > 0.7), auto-investigate and block C2

triggers.name: RITA Beacon Alert
triggers.description: RITA posts beacon alerts to this endpoint

body.query: SELECT Pid, Name, CommandLine, Username FROM pslist() WHERE Name =~ '(nc|ncat|python|curl)'

parameters.title: C2 Beaconing Detected: $parse-beacon.source_ip → $parse-beacon.destination_ip
parameters.description:
RITA beacon score: $parse-beacon.beacon_score
Connections: $parse-beacon.connection_count
Source: $parse-beacon.source_ip
Destination: $parse-beacon.destination_ip

Velociraptor process check: $velociraptor-query.result
